title: AIBody message companion app -> AIBody plugin ("command"), protocol v3

id.description: Unique id; echoed as reply_to / utterance_id

ack.description: Request an ack event on success

audio.description: speak: audio file path relative to the VaM folder (default Custom/Sounds/AIBody/<channel>/...)

expression.description: speak: expression to show while speaking

hold.description: expression: seconds before returning to neutral (<=0 = keep)

duration.description: speak: expected clip length in s (informational); gesture: s

path.description: pose: preset path, may include a .var reference

queue.description: speak: append to the playback queue (default) or stop current speech and clear the queue

mic_state.description: config_ack: same fields as a mic_state message

vad.description: mic_state: the voice detector that really runs, e.g. 'energy (built-in, adaptive noise floor), strictness 2'

vad_note.description: mic_state: why the chosen voice detector is not used (e.g. webrtcvad not installed); absent when all is as chosen

rms.description: mic_level: peak RMS (0..1) since the last level message

session.description: companion_heartbeat: id that changes on every companion start (the AIBody plugin then re-sends ready + config)

engines_available.description: companion_heartbeat: engine names per kind, fills the AIBody plugin's engine menus

engines_status.description: companion_heartbeat: kind -> engine -> status text ("bereit (...)" / "nicht konfiguriert: ...")

engines_active.description: companion_heartbeat: kind -> engine that really runs (a fallback if the selected one is not configured)

keys.description: companion_heartbeat: API key status per provider (xai, elevenlabs): state configured | missing | rejected, detail = where the key comes from / why it is missing, hint = which kind of key works (never the key)

hint.description: when missing / rejected: which key works (xAI: an API key from console.x.ai; a Grok subscription / grok.com token does not)

audio_out.description: companion_heartbeat: folder (below the VaM folder) the speech WAVs are written to; auto = chosen automatically (Custom/Sounds/AIBody/<channel>, switched once to Saves/PluginData/AIBody/<channel>/audio if VaM cannot load them); note = audio folder problem / switch

turn.description: companion_heartbeat: last question / answer step or problem ("Gehört: ...", "Antwort ...", "Sprachmodell-Fehler: ..."), shown in the plugin's status box

latency.description: companion_heartbeat: time from the end of the user's speech to the first sound {last_s, avg_s, n, parts}

personas.description: companion_heartbeat: names of the persona folders (Saves/PluginData/AIBody/personas/<name>/persona.json); fills the plugin's Persona menu

persona.description: companion_heartbeat: the persona in use ("" = none: the plain ai.persona text)

persona_note.description: companion_heartbeat: why the chosen persona is not used (not found, unreadable), else empty

memory.description: companion_heartbeat: memory state {enabled, facts (number of remembered facts), note}

figures.description: companion_heartbeat: the channels this app serves when it runs several figures (absent with one figure)

active_figure.description: companion_heartbeat: the channel of the figure the user is talking to (only with several figures)

target.description: look_at: where the eyes look: client = the Client Character (its head; the camera if there is none), camera = the player's view (VR headset / screen), forward = straight ahead, away = a short glance to the side, off = stop directing the gaze (back to the menu's Default gaze), atom = the atom named in 'atom'

atom.description: look_at with target 'atom': the atom's name (uid) in the scene

seconds.description: look_at: how long to keep looking there, then back to the default gaze (0 / missing = until changed; 'away' defaults to 3 s)
